verdict.rationale: Bruno documents importing Postman collections (with a preserve-scripts option) and stores collections as plain-text .bru files in a folder, which supports Git-based portability; community feedback corroborates users migrating from Postman using this import. However, evidence does not show export to standard formats like OpenAPI (openapi probe returned 404s) or interoperability beyond Postman import. Missing for 10: documented export to Postman/OpenAPI/other standard formats, evidence of round-trip export, independent confirmation of import fidelity beyond scripts.
